entities.statement: Street boy: vulnerable child searching for his mother and trying to survive hunger.
Disheveled woman: the boy's mother; portrayed as injured, amnesiac, homeless and hungry.
Black couple operating the food stall: initially confront the child, then show compassion and provide food/money.
Dark-haired suited man: high-status observer with a driver; may recognize the mother later.
